sign_up_offers.terms:
SingSaver Exclusive Welcome Offer promotion is valid from 1 September 2026 to 30 September 2026.
Promotion is valid for new customers of DCS cards only.
Apply and get approved for the DCS Ultimate Platinum UnionPay Card and meet the min. spend criteria within 30 days of card approval to be eligible for reward:
Make a min. spend of S$500 within 30 days of card approval to be eligible for a 
20-inch GOTRIP Luggage Bag
.
Make a min. spend of S$800 within 30 days of card approval to be eligible for a 
24-inch GOTRIP Luggage Bag
.
You will only receive one of the above rewards.
Additionally, accumulate a min. spend of S$1,000 in Qualifying Transactions within 30 days of the card approval date to be eligible for a 
S$50 Gojek Voucher
 on top of the above reward.
All of the above rewards are fulfilled by DCS.
Terms and Conditions
 apply.

extra.description: Stop overthinking your rewards and start accumulating serious global perks! The DCS Ultimate Platinum UnionPay Card drops a flat, effortless 2% cashback* into your wallet when you buy—with absolutely zero minimum spend hoops to jump through. Built with an ultra-sleek, numberless layout for bulletproof identity security, you can also explore mainland China completely hassle-free with a 3% transaction fee waiver on all Alipay and WeChat pay purchases. Even better, it unlocks the VIP treatment with exclusive UnionPay power-moves: a complimentary Sands Rewards LifeStyle Elite tier membership and up to 10% off at over 100 International Airport Duty-Free shops.
